name: THOMAS CHACRA
tagline: Environmental bioengineer, compliance and environmental management systems
addressee: To the EAP recruiting team, Amazon France.
subject: Application: Environmental Compliance Manager, Thomas Chacra
paragraphs: A permit is only worth the evidence file behind it. Most of the work is not the application itself but the year of monitoring records, waste transfers and utility readings that let you answer an inspector without scrambling. That is the part of environmental compliance I find worth doing, and it is why the EAP team's scope across air, stormwater, waste, wastewater and energy interests me.

I have built and run the reporting side of that work: carbon footprints under the GHG Protocol, environmental indicators and monitoring KPIs, automated Excel and Power BI tools that carried the recurring reporting load. I also took part in gap analyses against ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001. That tells you what an auditor asks for, and where the evidence usually stops. On the regulatory side I have assessed environmental constraints on energy installations and followed French and EU requirements closely enough to know how much national and local variation sits underneath them.

What I have not done is hold a multi-site compliance programme of this size. I will not pretend otherwise. What I bring is the technical grounding, the habit of documenting a claim so it survives scrutiny, and C1 English with C1 French. I am based in Brussels and ready for the travel across France and the EU.
I would welcome a conversation about the role, and I am glad to hear your feedback either way.
